species.name: Crappie
why: Water 56°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–22 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 95 ft, so fish stay above it.
